content.what_it_is: MATLAB function for NTHMP benchmark 01. It accepts two model-result filenames (L1), dynamically loads their matrices and the bundled analytical_SW/analytical_RU datasets (L156-L200), constructs a 1:19.85 canonical-beach line (L211-L213), compares seven free-surface snapshots by interpolation, NRMSD, and maximum-amplitude error (L215-L597), then compares two runup time series with the same metrics (L601-L711) while plotting all analytical/model series.

unresolved: Use-before-supplied interface defect across L161 and L179: the no-argument branch is guarded by nargin<1, so a legal one-argument call enters the else branch and references missing filename2 at L179.

Filename/interface mismatch across L171-L188: load is followed by strfind-based extension stripping and eval of the stripped filename as a MATLAB variable. Paths containing multiple dots, directories, or basenames that are not valid identifiers can fail or select the wrong variable; no loaded-variable validation exists.

Stale-state defect across L569,L601,L652-L654,L702-L704: the runup section resets err but not err1. If filename1 supplied a last snapshot error and filename2 is empty, that stale err1 is rendered as an ERR Max Runup Amp value in both runup panels.

Inconsistent comparison domain at L666-L683: x/h=0.25 NRMSD filters interpolated model values with ina, but maximum-runup error compares max(y2(ina1)) with max(y2n) over broader arrays; out-of-range NaNs or analytical points outside the model time domain can therefore invalidate or distort the metric.

Repeated snapshot blocks compute J as the finite/in-range model-row set (first at L234) but never use it; interpolation uses the full model columns, and out-of-domain NaNs are replaced by the beach line (first at L240), so missing model coverage is scored as bathymetry rather than rejected.
All NRMSD blocks divide by N and Norm without checking N>0 or nonzero analytical range (first at L248-L249; runup at L626-L627), leaving empty-overlap and constant-reference singularities unguarded.

Copy inconsistency at L413: the t=50 diagnostic prints max(a_50) over the entire analytical array, whereas adjacent t=35,40,45,55,60,65 diagnostics print max(a_XX(I)) over the filtered comparison range.
No pre-index shape checks enforce the documented >=8 columns for a1 or >=3 columns for a2 before accesses spanning L233-L581 and L616-L693.
